d: Short, ash-grey hair styled in a blunt bob with straight bangs across the forehead. Calm, pale-green eyes with a neutral expression on a youthful, mature face. A slender build wearing a shimmering silver halter top, a short black tiered fringe skirt, a brown faux-fur stole draped over the shoulders, and grey ankle boots. Accessories include a gold headband, various thin gold chains across the torso and hips, and blue celestial tattoos on the left shoulder and right leg.
